# Planning and Control {#sec-planning-control}

::: {.callout-note title="Outline scaffold"}

This page makes the agreed chapter architecture renderable in Quarto. It records the chapter question, planned coverage, and intended systems outcome; full manuscript prose, figures, worked examples, fallacies, and exercises remain to be developed.

:::

## Chapter Question {.unnumbered}

_When does explicit planning improve an agent, and when does it add cost without improving outcomes?_

## Planned Coverage

- Reactive policies, plans, search trees, and receding-horizon control
- Test-time compute allocation and stopping rules
- Uncertainty-aware branching and pruning
- Deterministic controllers around stochastic decisions
- Plan repair after environmental change

## Intended Systems Outcome

Readers should be able to match a control strategy to task horizon, observability, branching factor, and verification cost.
